summary: Frontend-only smoke + feature testing for Iteration 6 (brand rename PIRATE.RADIO → SPARKZ.TV and new LiveSidebar). All 9 acceptance criteria verified via Playwright against the preview URL as user sidebar_fb6144@sparkz.tv. Every criterion passes with one caveat: the browser document.title is overridden at runtime by the injected emergent-main.js analytics script (renders as 'Emergent | Fullstack App'), even though the source <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html is correctly set to 'Sparkz.TV — Underground Live Streaming'. This is external to app code and cannot be fixed from the frontend.

action_items: OPTIONAL/INFO: Runtime document.title is overridden by the Emergent analytics script (emergent-main.js) to 'Emergent | Fullstack App'. The <title> in index.html source is correct. If the exact browser tab title matters, main agent may set document.title via a useEffect in App.js after mount to force it back to 'Sparkz.TV — Underground Live Streaming'.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveSidebar.jsx polling uses setInterval(load, 15000) with cancelled flag + clearInterval on unmount — clean.

useSidebarCollapsed() polls localStorage every 300ms to sync same-tab writes. Works but a shared context/callback would be cleaner and avoid the 300ms delay between toggle and main-content padding update.
Sidebar uses 'hidden lg:flex' as intentional design; verified — no sidebar on mobile viewport as expected.
